documents.title: Part B: Technical Description of the Project

sub.label: Project Summary (see Abstract from Part A)
prompts: Provide a concise summary of your project. See the Abstract field in the Administrative Form (Part A).

sub.label: 1.1 Background and general objectives
prompts: Provide a presentation of the applicant company and partners: management, activities, present position in national and European markets, editorial line in terms of development and production. For European slate and mini-slate development, describe company development plans and financial status (total turnover and development expenditure for the last two financial years in EUR).

sub.label: 1.2 Needs analysis and specific objectives
prompts: Describe how the slate improves your company's position on the European and international market: co-production approach, partnership with different countries, visibility at major film festivals and markets, capacity to increase turnover, capacity to increase number and ambition of projects in development. Explain the added value of your approach and how production companies will collaborate on joint development of creative aspects and storytelling.

sub.label: 1.3 European added value
prompts: Describe how the slate demonstrates the company's ability to adapt to a competitive and changing audiovisual landscape through innovation in genres, formats, platforms, emerging talents or new territories.

sub.label: 1.4 Environment and sustainability
prompts: Describe strategies to ensure a more sustainable and environmentally respectful industry.

sub.label: 1.5 Gender balance, inclusion and diversity
prompts: Describe strategies to ensure gender balance, inclusion, diversity and representativeness, either in the project or content, or in managing activities.

sub.label: 2.1 Concept and methodology
prompts: Describe the approach to storytelling, visual approach, graphic and sound design, and accessibility measures. For video games and immersive content, describe gameplay integration, level and character design, and immersive experience approach. Provide comprehensive market analysis justifying methodological and strategic choices.

sub.label: 2.2 Format
prompts: Explain how the budget, objectives and proposed content ensure feasibility. Describe quality and innovative aspects of promotion, marketing and activities to increase audience engagement. For video games, describe gameplay mechanics and storytelling integration.

sub.label: 2.3 Potential
prompts: For each project in the slate or mini-slate, describe its potential to cross borders, taking into account the subject, creative team, intended cast and collaboration with non-national partners. Explain how the action will engage young and digital native audiences (children, teenagers and young adults). For video games, describe potential transnational appeal based on subject, type and localization strategy.

sub.label: 2.4 Cost effectiveness and financial management
prompts: Demonstrate the cost effectiveness of your action. Explain how the estimated budget is conceived in the most economical way. Explain your co-financing strategy if applicable.

sub.label: 2.5 Risk management
prompts: Describe critical risks, uncertainties or difficulties related to implementation. For each risk, indicate the impact and likelihood (high, medium, low), and propose mitigation measures.

sub.label: 3.1 Partnership and consortium, roles and tasks division
prompts: Describe overall distribution of roles and responsibilities between partners, division of tasks, budget split, administrative cooperation and risk management. Explain how members of production and creative team will collaborate. For consortia, describe how consortium coordination will work.

sub.label: 3.2 Project teams
prompts: Describe the project teams and how they will work together. List main staff by function and profile, describing their tasks briefly.

sub.label: 3.3 Development strategy
prompts: Describe the stage at which the project is submitted and its needs in terms of development. Describe envisaged activities during development, the development schedule until production start (scriptwriting, script editing, research, director choice, casting, locations, filming start date). Provide breakdown of development budget. Indicate key dates and especially production phase start dates.

sub.label: 3.4 Financing strategy
prompts: Describe the strategy to finance the development of the submitted project. Describe the financing strategy for production and draft a preliminary finance plan. Mention main options, potential partners at national and European/international level, and initial financial elements already in place or to be confirmed.

sub.label: 4.1 Communication, promotion and marketing
prompts: Describe the intended marketing strategy (national and international) to reach audiences early, including definition of unique selling points, target audiences and markets, innovative marketing and audience engagement tools, and promotional activities.

sub.label: 4.2 Dissemination and distribution
prompts: Describe the planned distribution strategy at national and European/international level, taking into account identified target audience, distribution methods foreseen and distribution partners already in place or envisaged. Explain which countries you consider important for distribution and why. Describe the choice and financial involvement of distribution companies or sales agents and their experience with similar projects.

sub.label: 4.3 Impact
prompts: Describe the expected impact of the project on the audiovisual industry, audiences, and the European cultural sector. Explain how the project contributes to cultural diversity and European integration.

sections.label: 5. Workplan, Work Packages, Activities, Resources and Timing

sub.label: 5.1 Work plan
prompts: Provide an overview of how your project is structured in terms of work packages (WPs) and activities. Describe the logical sequence of work and main interdependencies.

sub.label: 5.2 Work packages, activities, resources and timing
prompts: For each work package: describe activities, define deliverables, identify responsible partners, allocate resources (personnel, equipment, subcontracting), indicate duration and timing. Include work package overview table with activities, duration, lead partner and resources.

sub.label: 5.3 Timetable
prompts: Provide a detailed timetable showing major milestones and deliverables for each work package. Include Gantt chart or timeline showing start and end dates, interdependencies and critical path.

sub.label: 6.1 Ethics
prompts: If the project involves ethics issues (human participants, personal data, sensitive content, etc.), provide self-assessment. Describe how ethical concerns will be addressed and compliance ensured.

sub.label: 6.2 Security
prompts: If the project involves EU classified information or other security issues, provide self-assessment. Describe security measures and compliance with relevant regulations.

sub.label: Declarations of honour
prompts: Declarations confirming: explicit consent of all applicants on participation and proposal content; information is correct and complete; no activities started before submission; compliance with eligibility criteria; not subject to exclusion grounds; financial and operational capacity to implement project.
